_notes: Initial gates from BUILD_PACKET section 16, keyed per dataset. scripts/eval_accuracy.py
checks a gate only for datasets it actually scored, and only for metrics that applied to
at least one item of that dataset (GiantSteps Tempo has no key truth, so its key gates
are reported as n/a). Raise a number here only after data/eval/latest.json shows the
pipeline clearing it with margin; see scripts/README.md.
synthetic.bpm_exact is 0.50, not 0.80: the synthetic tempos are uniform over 65-175 BPM
with hats on every eighth, so the exact octave is a convention the hip-hop prior (95 BPM,
OPEN_QUESTIONS 14 and 37) decides against on the fast and slow items by design; the set
scored 0.562 exact and 1.000 octave-tolerant on 2026-09-13. The 0.80 stays for the public
sets and the corrections set, where the material sets the octave.

harmonix carries the packet's numbers: it is real popular music with human beat, downbeat and segment annotations, so unlike the synthetic set its tempo octave is a fact about the record, not a convention. It has no key truth, so its key gates report n/a.
